topic: The character meant to die in episode 1 — kept alive by fan outcry
hook: This character was meant to die in episode 1. Fans changed it.
script: This character was meant to die in episode 1. Fans changed it. Piccolo in Dragon Ball was written to die in the first episode of the Z series. Test screenings caused such negative audience reaction that Toriyama rewrote the entire arc. Piccolo survived. Became one of the most beloved characters in anime history. A fan favourite who only exists because early viewers protested loudly enough. Follow for anime characters who almost never existed.
